content_blocks.label: clause_1._GRANTOR
content_blocks.text: I, Marianne Foster, being of sound mind and body, make this my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: All of my real and personal property hereafter described, and all property which I may thereafter acquire, shall be disposed of as follows:

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: I hereby appoint my nephew, David Sinclair, as the Executor of this Will.
